items.t: Rocket Lab (RKLB) Completed Its 101st Electron Launch
items.sum: Rocket Lab (NasdaqGS:RKLB) completed its 101st Electron launch, carrying Synspective's 14th StriX satellite to orbit. The mission marked Rocket Lab's 22nd Electron flight of 2026, reinforcing its role in small-lift orbital services.
